title: 所有子字符串中的元音
summary: 对字符串所有子字符串，累计其中元音字符出现次数。
insight: 下标 i 的字符被包含在 (i+1)*(n-i) 个子字符串中；若它是元音，把这个贡献直接加入答案。
pitfalls: 按每个子字符串中的出现次数累计

solutions.title: 按位置计算子串贡献
solutions.idea: 把双重子串枚举转为每个元音位置的组合数。
steps: 遍历 i，判断 word[i] 是否在 aeiou

code.java: class Solution { public long countVowels(String word){long answer=0;for(int i=0;i<word.length();i++)if("aeiou".indexOf(word.charAt(i))>=0)answer+=(long)(i+1)*(word.length()-i);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countVowels(word:String):Long{var answer=0L;for(i in word.indices)if(word[i] in "aeiou")answer+=(i+1).toLong()*(word.length-i);return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: long long countVowels(string word){long long answer=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)word.size();++i)if(string("aeiou").find(word[i])!=string::npos)answer+=1LL*(i+1)*(word.size()-i);return answer;} };
